prompt: The signed-in user's own exhibitions as cover cards, led by a 'Curate a new exhibition' card; self-loading, with signed-out, empty, loading and error states.
shortDesc: The signed-in user's own exhibitions as cover cards, most recently updated first, always led by a 'Curate a new exhibition' card linking to /exhibitions/new (so no separate button is needed). Takes no data: it loads the exhibitions itself (ListExhibitions), so don't wrap it in g-grid and don't write g-exhibition-card by hand. Signed-out visitors see a sign-in message instead, so keep surrounding texts valid for both. Use it on /exhibitions inside <g-page-section level="1" heading="My exhibitions">: <g-exhibition-list></g-exhibition-list>. As a home-page teaser: <g-exhibition-list limit="3" layout="rail"></g-exhibition-list> inside a g-page-section with link-href="/exhibitions". Any use with limit (grid or rail) shows only part of the list and has no link to the rest itself, so always put it in a g-page-section with link-href="/exhibitions". limit is a whole number (exhibitions shown after the New card); layout is "grid" (default) or "rail".

props.name: limit
props.description: Show at most this many exhibitions after the New card, e.g. "3" (default all). Display only: never changes the request. The component doesn't link to the rest, so any limited use (grid or rail) belongs in a g-page-section with link-href="/exhibitions"; in grid layout the count line then reads 'Showing 3 of 7 · Most recent first'.

props.name: layout
props.description: "grid" (default: responsive columns of at least 260px, with a count line) or "rail" (one horizontally scrolling row of 240px cards with prev/next buttons; for teasers).

props.name: empty-text
props.description: Shown under the New card when the user has no exhibitions yet. Default "You haven't curated anything yet. Start an exhibition, then use “Add to exhibition” on any artwork page."

styling.tailwindClasses: grid grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(260px,100%),1fr))] gap-6; rail: flex gap-6 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory [&>li]:flex-[0_0_240px]; new card: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2.5 min-h-[280px] border-[1.5px] border-dashed border-stone-300 rounded-sm text-center
styling.notes: VITRINE kit. A <ul role=list> of cells that stretch to equal height. The first cell is always the New card: an <a href=/exhibitions/new> with a dashed 1.5px --rule border, a 64px gilt-ringed circle holding a large oxblood '＋' (Newsreader), 'Curate a new exhibition' in italic Newsreader 20px and a --soft 13px hint; hover/focus-visible turns the border oxblood on an --oxblood-tint ground, fills the circle oxblood, underlines the title and lifts 2px (static under prefers-reduced-motion). Grid layout adds a small-caps --soft count line ('4 exhibitions · Most recent first', or 'Showing 3 of 7 · Most recent first' when limit trims the list). Rail: 44px square prev/next buttons (paper, hairline border, oxblood on hover) above the row, hidden when nothing overflows and disabled at the ends; scroll is smooth unless reduced motion. Loading: 3 skeleton cards (4:3 --mat box + two lines, 1.6s pulse), aria-busy. Empty: the New card, then a hairline-topped serif 18px empty-text with links to /highlights and /collections. Signed out: a --paper panel with a gilt top rule, an oxblood kicker and 'Sign in with Google (top right) to curate and keep your own exhibitions.' in Newsreader 22px. Error: .error text plus a ghost 'Try again' button. Cover images come only from /__art URLs (others dropped, so the card shows its typographic placeholder).

dependencies.usage: One card per exhibition: exhibition-id=id, title, subtitle, artwork-count=artworkCount, image-url=coverImageUrl (only /__art URLs), updated-at=updatedAt.

interactions.trigger: component mounts (READS.exhibitions(), byte-identical to g-add-to-exhibition's request; sorted by updatedAt descending and trimmed by limit on the client; a 401 or sign-in error shows the signed-out panel)
interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'list my exhibitions (ListExhibitions)', outputFormat: { exhibitions: [{ id, title, subtitle, artworkCount, coverImageUrl, updatedAt }] } }
